reason: TempVerseFormer uses reversible Transformer blocks and time-agnostic backpropagation to reconstruct activations instead of storing them; the paper reports nearly constant training memory versus prediction horizon on a synthetic rotating-shape task. It explicitly says real-world data are needed to assess generalization. The benefit is training activation memory, not LLM inference/KV memory, so the sparse-attention/long-context link is weak.
title: Temporal modeling with reversible transformers
